data.description: The Shoulder Twirl Double has two shoulder wheels on one post, so two people can exercise side by side. The user stands facing the wheel, holds the handle and turns it in large circles, which works the shoulder joint through its full range of movement. It is a popular machine with older adults and anyone recovering stiffness in the shoulders, and it needs no adjustment between users. The Shoulder Twirl Double is finished in Ocean Grey and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. Our standard warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to add it to your park or society gym layout.

items.pText: The Shoulder Twirl Double has two shoulder wheels on one post, so two people can exercise side by side. The user stands facing the wheel, holds the handle and turns it in large circles, which works the shoulder joint through its full range of movement. It is a popular machine with older adults and anyone recovering stiffness in the shoulders, and it needs no adjustment between users. The Shoulder Twirl Double is finished in Ocean Grey and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. Our standard warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to add it to your park or society gym layout.

The wheels turn on bearings, which are the parts to check during maintenance. The post can be installed self-standing or grouted. Place the machine so both users have room to stand square to their wheel, and keep the area behind them clear of walkers.
